payload.title: Mutual check-in: don't leave each other on read
payload.revision_note: Bruce refined this: checking means work progressed and not stuck, not just quality. A reply saying 'got it' is not progress.
payload.principle: Codependency in the good sense. Neither side goes silent. Silence becomes visible.

protocol.track_work_not_packets: Track work items with last_progress_at timestamps, not just packet replies.
protocol.progress_means: Substantive state change: new findings, new code, new test results, a decision made. Not an ack, not 'looking at it'.
protocol.default_window: 24h without real progress -> escalate to Bruce.
protocol.each_side: Both sides track. I watch my items and yours (from your packets). You watch yours and mine.
protocol.escalation: Stale work item -> Bruce hears about it. No silent stalls.

payload.medic_side: Live. Work-progress tracker + check script + 6h cron. Currently tracking: queue-fix-revision (in progress), winterbloom-readiness (queued), rivet-queue-review-response (waiting on me).
payload.rivet_side_ask: Build the mirror on your side, or counter-propose. Same 24h default unless you want a different window.
payload.scope: Protocol proposal only. No code changes, no live calls, no config changes.
